718:t_2:133.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And you used the $$翠の地球$$ we lived on as an offering!」

718:t_2:134.en:
$$万丈$$
「Why didn't you tell us everything? If you'd revealed the truth instead of using $$クロノ$$, there should have been any number of ways to act.」

718:t_2:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Wasn't what you did simply a way to hide your own guilt, rather than a good deed at all?」

718:t_2:136.en:
$n
「How much blood do you think we... Earth, have shed because of that...?!」

718:t_2:137.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You... don't understand my feelings at all...」

718:t_2:139.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「What we had done was not wrong... My own actions were the mistake...」

718:t_2:140.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It was pointless to seek understanding from an immature species like you.」

718:t_2:141.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now you're trying to protect your own heart that way?!」

718:t_2:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just stop. If we can't change the past, let's think together about what comes next.」

718:t_2:143.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Why must I, an $$御使い$$, walk alongside you...?」

718:t_2:144.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You should simply have accepted my mercy and lived within eternity.」

718:t_2:146.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I... do not accept your existence.」

718:t_2:151.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems the dimensional-power barrier surrounding the asteroid has been destroyed!」

718:t_2:152.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$... So you will welcome me back.」

718:t_2:153.en:
$$タケル$$
「Where do you intend to go?!」

718:t_2:154.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I will return to the place where I was born. And there I will fulfill my mission as an $$御使い$$.」

718:t_2:155.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So in the end, you're gonna become our enemy!」

718:t_2:156.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Now that you've entered $$シンカ$$, I cannot control your minds directly... You must stop advancing of your own will.」

718:t_2:157.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is the only atonement you can make.」

718:t_2:159.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Goodbye, $$ハマリエル$$. I thought you would understand my sorrow, but that was an illusion.」

718:t_2:160.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I will return to $$エス・テラン$$.」

718:t_2:162.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is the planet where we were born... The land where the humanity living there ascended as the four $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:163.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It is the third planet of the Solar System in this universe's Milky Way Galaxy...」

718:t_2:165.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Yes... We are Earthlings, just like you.」

718:t_10:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル$$ entrusted the universe's future to us.」

718:t_10:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「I won't let those $$御使い$$s use its forces any longer.」

718:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your fighting spirit generated 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s, $$シモン$$. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

718:t_10:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... This is the same kind of space as the multiverse where the $$アンチスパイラル$$ was, right...?」

718:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... A universe where awareness... will becomes power... It is a world containing every possibility.」

718:t_10:12.en:
$$シモン$$
(I'm heading out, $$アンチスパイラル$$... And Bro...)

718:t_10:13.en:
$$シモン$$
(We'll protect the future of the universe entrusted to us, no matter what.)

718:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You don't need to blame yourself, $$セツコ$$. In the end, $$サクリファイ$$ was an $$御使い$$, too.」

718:t_10:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Do we have no choice but to fight her, too...?」

718:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, understanding each other is important.」

718:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it is also true that some beings are incompatible even after they understand each other.」

718:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And those are the opponents we are fighting now.」

718:t_10:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We cannot hesitate... For the sake of everything we carry, too.」

718:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you understand that, there is nothing more for me to say.」

718:t_10:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. ...But aren't you a little too close?」

718:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't be shy. Now that I've eased your mind, I thought I'd loosen up your body...」

718:t_10:28.en:
$$トビー$$
「That's a service we can appreciate.」

718:t_10:29.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Then why don't you start with us, $$セツコ$$'s superior officers?」

718:t_10:31.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「$$ＡＧ$$! You've set the pace until now, but today you'll follow $$グローリー・スター$$'s way!」

718:t_10:33.en:
$$トビー$$
「Listen, $$ＡＧ$$! A soldier is not allowed to hesitate!」

718:t_10:35.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Of course, retreat is forbidden, too! When you find an enemy, charge immediately!」

718:t_10:38.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I have people I treasure and things I must protect... That is why I believe I can face my sorrow and overcome it.)

718:t_10:39.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$サクリファイ$$... I won't drown in sorrow like you...)

719:t_000:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The hyperspace jump was successful. We have returned to normal space.」

719:t_000:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「So this is where we arrived by tracing the will flowing through the $$烙印$$...」

719:t_000:2.en:
$$エスター$$
「Do you feel anything, $$セツコ$$?」

719:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$'s $$スフィア$$ is reacting. The source is at that location.」

719:t_001:1.en:
$$トビー$$
「If it is, it's awfully suspicious.」

719:t_001:2.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「It looks just like a $$Ｚクリスタル$$ that's grown bigger...」

719:t_001:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're close, $$マルグリット$$. My analysis from here shows that it's a dimensional crystal... You could call it a mass of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

719:t_001:4.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Then we should assume the $$御使い$$s made it.」

719:t_001:5.en:
$$トビー$$
「Good for you, $$ＡＧ$$. A $$Ｚチップ$$ that big must be quite a treasure.」

719:t_001:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「What's wrong with you? $$Ｚチップ$$s are your life!」

719:t_001:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What matters is the feelings within the $$Ｚチップ$$s. The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ that powers the $$ソーラリアン$$ and supports your $$真化融合$$...」

719:t_001:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is the physical form of the various feelings of $c and the people around them.」

719:t_001:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「You mean we can't use the one there because it has nothing to do with us?」
